proof_scope: Internal mollified W1,2 chain rule and weak derivative zero-set locality, iterated to Hessians; Euclidean bounded distributional Laplacian implies local real W2,2 via a Cauchy gradient energy estimate and the compact-support Hessian/Laplacian norm identity. Continuous W2,2 pairs have identical weak complex coefficients on contact sets. Bounded complex-Hessian psh products have the normalized polarized determinant density; W2,2 barriers need only a contact-restricted determinant, which is locally bounded there. No general metric elliptic W2,p theorem, global barrier determinant integrability, full real C1,1 regularity or arbitrary psh contact theorem is inferred; no external input. Dimension zero is explicit.
